worldcombat.skill.skillswap.summary: Temporarily exchange Abilities, or exchange attack, movement and defensive attributes with a non-Pokémon.
worldcombat.skill.skillswap.use.0: Take the target's strong Ability for yourself
worldcombat.skill.skillswap.use.1: Hand your harmful Ability to the opponent
worldcombat.skill.skillswap.use.2: Break a foe that leans on its Ability
Select an opponent within %1$s blocks; the exchange lasts %2$s. Pokémon exchange their current eligible Abilities. Neither participant may already be in an exchange.
%1$s s wind-up, %2$s s recovery, %3$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.skillswap.hold.on: Deep exchange: duration x1.9 and cooldown x1.3, for using one good Ability across a stretch of the fight, but you cannot swap back meanwhile.
worldcombat.skill.skillswap.hold.off: Quick exchange: duration x0.7 and cooldown x0.9, cheap to cast and quick to undo, for trying out the opponent's Ability first.
worldcombat.skill.skillswap.timing: Cast on one opponent; after a %2$s s wind-up it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s s recovery, %5$s s cooldown from commit, current range %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.skillswap.growth.0: At level %1$s the exchange lasts %2$s and the cooldown from commit drops to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.skillswap.growth.1: At level %1$s the exchange lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops again to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.skillswap.preference.h: On = deep exchange: duration x1.9 and cooldown x1.3 for using one good Ability across a stretch. Off = quick exchange: duration x0.7 and cooldown x0.9 for trying the opponent's Ability first. Duration trades against cast frequency.
worldcombat.skill.skillswap.preference.a: The move is considered only when the threat is within this distance; larger means tracing from farther away, smaller means only at close range.
Consider only Abilities with a known world use. Disable to also try unfamiliar Abilities.
On: a holding companion will leave its post to swap Abilities. Off: it casts only where it already stands.
worldcombat.skill.skillswap.world: Against a non-Pokémon, temporarily exchange both participants’ current native attack damage, movement speed, armour, armour toughness and knockback resistance for %1$s. Cleansing either side restores both. Equipment stays with its owner, and later attribute changes still apply.
